headline: Kazakhstan signs $1.2 billion in climate funding agreements at COP31 in Antalya
summary: Kazakhstan secured $1.2 billion in climate-related investment deals during the COP31 UN conference in Antalya, Türkiye, as global negotiators review progress under the Paris Agreement.
why: Kazakhstan is Central Asia's largest economy. International climate agreements attract foreign direct investment into energy transition infrastructure.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Securing $1.2 billion in climate investment deals brings significant project capital into the country.
